verdict.rationale: Superset exposes a documented, machine-verified public API surface: a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.superset.sh/openapi.json, a hosted MCP server with OAuth-protected access, a TypeScript SDK, and a CLI, all covering workspaces, tasks, agents, and automations. This is corroborated by runtime probes (200s, working auth flow) rather than just docs claims. missing for 10: no independent third-party developer account of building against the API/SDK beyond the vendor's own docs and probes.
